title: TradeInCapabilities
description: Actual trade_in_submit behavior of one deployment. Publish in the A2A AAP extension params.skills["trade_in_submit"].capabilities and the MCP trade-in tool metadata; the same values apply to every binding.

instant_valuation.description: true when the dealer can answer with status valued in the same call, typically through a valuation API. false means every accepted submission returns received, as when the dealer delivers it to a CRM as an ADF/XML lead.

currencies.description: Currencies this skill accepts and returns. Omitted means only USD. Another vehicle currency returns SCHEMA_VALIDATION_FAILED naming /vehicle/currency.
